capture_mode: conservative official HM Land Registry exact-transaction legacy address enrichment with extended completion window
source_note: The already-completed exact-price HMLR sweeps for every available 2014-2018 Savills legacy year were audited for unique post-auction completions between 61 and 120 days. Only 2018 produced candidates. Ten addresses were retained where exact hammer price, locality or postcode district, tenure and a specific property subclass aligned to one transaction; four broad other-class candidates were rejected. Original evidence and every repeat appearance remain preserved.
